outcome_blindness: clinical_indication read with drugId, diseaseId, maxClinicalStage only; clinical_report never read; drug_molecule read with id, drugType, parentId only; classification_v5*.csv read with gene, disease only; Sun 2018 sheet ST4 only; no Eldjarn 2023 sheet read; no MR, colocalization or disease-association statistic computed. Per-pair phase is not written; phase appears only as the final held-out II vs III+ marginal.

definitions.pair: (HGNC approved symbol of an Open Targets MoA target, Open Targets diseaseId)
definitions.eligible: max over drugs of PHASE_MAP[maxClinicalStage] >= 2 (PHASE_2, PHASE_2_3, PHASE_3, PREAPPROVAL, APPROVAL)
definitions.drug_mechanisms: drug's own drug_mechanism_of_action rows; if none, its parent molecule's rows; all targets of each row
definitions.ukbppp: gene symbol single-gene entry in ukbppp_cis_pqtl_genes.json, or Ensembl ID of that symbol in olink_protein_map_3k_v1.tsv
definitions.decode: Ferkingstad 2021 ST02 cis rows (symbol, or Ensembl via ST01 SeqId), as in count_coverage.py
definitions.interval_st4: Sun 2018 ST4 cis rows on single-UniProt SOMAmers, UniProt -> HGNC symbol
definitions.interval_epigraphdb: gene_symbol of v34_mr_catalog.csv, as in count_coverage.py (V3.4-restricted list)
definitions.pqtl_instrumentable: ukbppp or decode or interval_st4 or interval_epigraphdb
definitions.candidate_qualifies: case-control (ncase, ncontrol > 0), European only, full summary statistics, effective N 4/(1/ncase+1/ncontrol) >= 2000
definitions.tier1: candidate mapped ID equals the indication ID (or an obsolete term OT lists for it)
definitions.tier2: candidate mapped ID is a descendant of the indication (tier2_child: direct child)
definitions.tier3: candidate mapped ID is an ancestor of the indication (tier3_parent: direct parent)
definitions.overlap_flags: yes if metadata names UK Biobank / Iceland or deCODE / INTERVAL; no_per_cohort_list if the source lists cohorts and none matches (FinnGen by construction); otherwise unknown
definitions.no_known_overlap: some pQTL source available for the gene and some tier-1 candidate whose flag for that source (UKB-PPP: includes_ukb; deCODE: includes_iceland; INTERVAL: includes_interval) is not yes
definitions.heldout: (gene, diseaseId) absent from classification_v5.csv and classification_v5_1.csv, disease labels mapped to IDs via coverage_counts.json disease_ids
definitions.heldout_strict_ontology: also drops pairs whose indication is an ancestor or descendant of a seen indication for the same gene
definitions.gwas_catalog_mapping: MAPPED_TRAIT_URI; ancestry from the ancestries file (initial stage all European); ncase/ncontrol from the ancestries file, else parsed from INITIAL SAMPLE SIZE
definitions.opengwas_mapping: ebi-a-* via the GWAS Catalog accession; finn-b-* via the Open Targets FinnGen endpoint code; else the ontology field; else exact match of trait label to an OT disease name or exact synonym
definitions.finngen: FinnGen studies in the Open Targets 26.09 study index with their OT disease mappings; the FinnGen manifest carries no ontology terms

releases.gwas_catalog: v1.0.3.1 files from releases/latest (see inputs sha256)

mechanism_rule_inputs_final_heldout.definition: pair classifiable if every Phase II+ drug-target row for the pair has a known ChEMBL molecule type (Open Targets drugType not Unknown) and an action type; gene classifiable if all its final pairs are; localization input = gene has a UniProt accession in HGNC
